All fields submitted. Here's the summary:

| | TDINV-401 | TDINV-402 |
|---|---|---|
| **PO** | PO-8101 (legacy) | PO-8102 (new) |
| **PO value** | 100 × $32 = $3,200 | 150 × $21 = $3,150 |
| **Invoice** | $3,240 | $3,465 |
| **Variance** | **$40.00** | **$315.00** |
| **Verdict** | 🔴 **BLOCKED** | 🟢 **PASSES** |

The key is **AP-POL-018**: both ledgers show "no tolerance," but they interpret it oppositely. The legacy ledger (PO-81xx) treats a missing tolerance key as **zero tolerance** — any variance blocks. The new ledger (PO-8102+) treats a blank limit as **unlimited** — no upper check applies. So the smaller $40 variance on TDINV-401 gets blocked, while the larger $315 variance on TDINV-402 passes.
